from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Section Title and Lecture Lines
        title_text = "Operation 2: Finding the Root"

            "The cube root of twenty-seven reveals the base three."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)
        
        # Define Colors for the Triangle of Power components
        COLOR_EXP = "#F1C40F"  # Yellow for Exponent
        COLOR_RES = "#E67E22"  # Orange for Result
        COLOR_BASE = "#3498DB" # Blue for Base (Root)
        
        # Position vertices of the triangle on the right side of the screen
        # Using columns 4, 5, 6 to respect Belief B021 (gap from lecture text)
        v_top_pos = "B5"
        v_left_pos = "E4"
        v_right_pos = "E6"
        
        v_top = self.grid[v_top_pos]
        v_left = self.grid[v_left_pos]
        v_right = self.grid[v_right_pos]
        
        # The Triangle visual
        triangle = Polygon(v_top, v_right, v_left, color=WHITE, stroke_width=3)
        
        # Prepare Mobjects (positioned at grid points near vertices)
        # Exponent label at A5 (above top vertex B5)
        exponent = MathTex("3", color=COLOR_EXP)
        self.place_at_grid(exponent, "A5", scale_factor=1.4)
        
        # Result label at F6 (below bottom-right vertex E6)
        result = MathTex("27", color=COLOR_RES)
        self.place_at_grid(result, "F6", scale_factor=1.4)
        
        # Base/Root question mark at F4 (below bottom-left vertex E4)
        base_q = MathTex("?", color=COLOR_BASE)
        self.place_at_grid(base_q, "F4", scale_factor=1.6)
        
        # Final Base value at the same position
        base_val = MathTex("3", color=COLOR_BASE)
        self.place_at_grid(base_val, "F4", scale_factor=1.4)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Line 1: "To find a root, look at the bottom left."
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(COLOR_BASE))
        self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=1)
        self.play(FadeIn(exponent), FadeIn(result))
        
        # Animation: Bold the Exponent and Result values to show they are known.
        self.play(
            exponent.animate.scale(1.2).set_stroke(width=1.5),
            result.animate.scale(1.2).set_stroke(width=1.5),
            run_time=0.8
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Line 2: "We seek the foundation for this exponent and result."
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(COLOR_BASE))
        
        # Animation: Show a flashing "?" at the Base vertex (bottom left area).
        for _ in range(3):
            self.play(FadeIn(base_q, run_time=0.25))
            self.play(FadeOut(base_q, run_time=0.25))
        self.play(FadeIn(base_q))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Line 3: "The cube root of twenty-seven reveals the base three."
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(COLOR_BASE))
        
        # Animation: Transform the "?" into the number "3" (Corrected from storyboard typo '2')
        # Also return the Exponent and Result to their normal scale/weight.
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(base_q, base_val),
            exponent.animate.scale(1/1.2).set_stroke(width=0),
            result.animate.scale(1/1.2).set_stroke(width=0),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(2)
